_purpose: Whole-TB migration reconciliation (tbrecon). Three independent streams: A PRODUCT_S3 asset-type balances, B INTERNAL_CUS_ACC one-to-one accounts, C PL. Edit with care: every run records the hash of this file.

currency.evidence: Matches 3-letter ISO pattern in the historical example AC.1.TR.QAR.3717...

product.evidence: UNCONFIRMED. Token 5 (example 5261). Candidate PRODUCT segment; see POSSIBLE_MAPPING_COLUMN_MISALIGNMENT diagnostic

sector.evidence: Position used by the existing ECB loader (bank_data.py parts[6], example 1000). Not confirmed against CONSOLIDATE.COND

pl_category.evidence: categ_data.py: validated against PL.CATEGORY on every row of the September category extract (NBS_SOURCE_REVIEW.md)

PL._note: Sector and residence positions in the PL key are NOT defined. PL rules restricting them need explicit SECTOR / RESIDENCE source columns, otherwise the rule is reported as DIMENSION_NOT_AVAILABLE.

sign_convention._note: Multiplier applied to each source before comparison. 1 = amounts are already in the same signed (debit positive) convention. Never change to make a difference disappear: record the evidence for the convention.

gl_class_from_target._note: Optional prefix -> BS / PL / OBS classification when the TB file has no CLASS column
